description: This file contains C source code for a cache manipulation routine used in a LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It includes functions to flush and invalidate cache regions, utilizing inline assembly for cache operations, and references configuration headers for cache line size.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Clears and invalidates cache lines within the specified memory region, aligning addresses to cache line boundaries.
